models.name: todo_app_configurations
models.description: System-wide configuration settings that control operational behavior such as session timeouts, encryption parameters, and feature flags. This table is referenced by other components to retrieve runtime settings. Each configuration is identified by a unique key and may include an optional description for context. This is a subsidiary table managed through system administration tools, not user-facing interfaces.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the configuration setting (e.g., 'session_timeout_minutes', 'encrypt_data_at_rest'). Required for lookup.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: The actual configuration value. Serialized as string (JSON, text, number as string) to support any data type. Example: "30" for 30 minutes, "{\"algorithm\": \"aes-256\"}" for complex settings.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description explaining the purpose, acceptable values, or implications of this configuration. Used for documentation and support.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this configuration was first created. Required for audit trails.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to this configuration. Required for audit trails.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp indicating when this configuration was logically deleted. Used for soft delete capability if needed in the future. If null, the configuration is active.

models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
Core user entity for authenticated individuals who create and manage their own todo items. This table contains only authentication and identity data. User accounts must be verified before accessing todo data. All other user data is stored in todo_app_todos, connected via user_id. This table is not joined with any table in otherTables outside this component.

Primary role: authentication endpoint subject. Follows strict write-once security model for passwords.

Referenced by: todo_app_user_sessions (via user_id).

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for user registration and authentication. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt-hashed password. Never stores plain text password. Generated during registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. UTC time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to user account details. Updated on password change or profile modification.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, account is active. If set, account is deleted and all associated data is eligible for purging after 72 hours as per privacy policy.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description:
Records user authentication sessions. Each session is tied to a single user and represents an active login from a specific device or browser. Session tokens are issued upon successful authentication and consumed for API access. Sessions are managed entirely by the authentication system and do not require direct user interaction. This table is strictly subsidiary since users do not create, fetch, or manage sessions directly.

Developed per requirements: session management requires specific fields (ip, href, referrer) and follow exact spec. Never store tokens, device info, or user agent.

Referenced by: none. Only referenced from authentication layer.

Follows session table pattern exactly.

Note: This is a subsidiary table: sessions are created and managed by the authentication system based on login events, not directly user-controlled.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticating user. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the device from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the connection endpoint used for login.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating where the user came from when logging in.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The moment the session was created and the access token was issued. UTC time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: The expiration time of this session. Null indicates an active (not expired) session. Session is invalidated once expired.

models.name: todo_app_admins
models.description:
Core admin entity with elevated privileges to access and manage all user accounts and todo items. This table contains only authentication and identity data for system administrators. Admin accounts are strictly controlled and should only be created via out-of-band mechanisms. Admins can access all user data but their own identity is isolated from users. This table is not joined with any table in otherTables outside this component.

Primary role: administrative system endpoint subject. Follows strict write-once security model for passwords.

Referenced by: todo_app_admin_sessions (via admin_id).

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for admin registration and authentication. Must be unique across all admins.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt-hashed password. Never stores plain text password. Generated during registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. UTC time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to admin account details. Updated on password change or profile modification.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, account is active. If set, account is deleted. Admin deletion is irreversible and triggers full audit trail.

models.name: todo_app_admin_sessions
models.description:
Records admin authentication sessions. Each session is tied to a single admin and represents an active login session from an administrative console. This is critical for audit trails. Session tokens are issued upon successful admin login and consumed for administrative API access. Sessions are managed entirely by the authentication system and do not require direct admin interaction. This table is strictly subsidiary since admins do not create, fetch, or manage sessions directly.

Developed per requirements: session management requires specific fields (ip, href, referrer) and follow exact spec. Never store tokens, device info, or user agent.

Referenced by: none. Only referenced from authentication layer.

Follows session table pattern exactly.

Note: This is a subsidiary table: sessions are created and managed by the authentication system based on admin login events, not directly user-controlled.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticating admin. {@link todo_app_admins.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the device from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the connection endpoint used for login.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating where the admin came from when logging in.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The moment the session was created and the access token was issued. UTC time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: The expiration time of this session. Null indicates an active (not expired) session. Session is invalidated once expired.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description: Individual task items created by authenticated users. Each todo is owned exclusively by one user and contains an actionable item represented by a text title. Completion status is binary: either true (completed) or false (incomplete). The system does not track historical versions, priorities, categories, or tags. This model satisfies 3NF as all fields depend solely on the primary key and there are no transitive dependencies. Reference user via {@link todo_app_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The authenticated user who created this todo item. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The text content of the todo item. Must be between 1 and 255 characters. Whitespace-only strings are not allowed. This is the only user-editable field besides completion status. Field must be non-null per business requirement.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Binary flag indicating if the todo item has been completed. Default is false when created. Users may toggle this status any number of times. This represents state, not progress.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created. Set automatically by system upon creation and immutable thereafter.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last updated (title or completion status changed). Updated automatically by system.

models.name: todo_app_auth_logs
models.description: Authentication logs record all login attempts, both successful and failed, by users and administrators. This table is critical for security monitoring and compliance. Each entry includes the actor type, IP address, and timestamp. Used to detect brute force attacks and unauthorized access attempts. Indexes on actor_type and created_at enable efficient query patterns for security analytics.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the actor who attempted authentication. Either a user or admin depending on actor_type. {@link todo_app_users.id} for users, {@link todo_app_admins.id} for admins.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who attempted authentication: "user" or "admin". This field defines which subtype table to join with and enforces referential integrity at the database level by eliminating null dependencies.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the authentication attempt occurred.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the login request originated.

plainFields.name: success
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the authentication attempt was successful (true) or failed (false).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the authentication attempt was recorded, in UTC.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this log record, in UTC. Always equal to created_at since logs are append-only.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this log entry was soft deleted. Always null in practice, since audit log entries are retained for 90 days per compliance policy and never truly deleted.

models.name: todo_app_audit_logs
models.description: Audit logs track all administrative actions performed on the system, including user account management, todo item access/modification/deletion, and system configuration changes. This table ensures accountability and supports regulatory compliance. Each entry records who performed the action, what was modified, and when. Reference: {@link todo_app_admins.id} for the admin actor, {@link todo_app_users.id} for affected users, and {@link todo_app_todos.id} for modified todo items.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin who performed this audit action. {@link todo_app_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the target user if this audit event affected a user account. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the todo item affected by this audit action, if any. {@link todo_app_todos.id}.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Type of administrative action performed (e.g., "create_user", "delete_todo", "access_user_todo_list", "reset_password").

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the administrative action was performed.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Free-text details about the action performed, such as old and new values, or context for the change. For example: "User John Doe was deleted" or "Todo 'Buy milk' changed from incomplete to complete".

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrative action occurred, in UTC.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this audit log record, in UTC. Always equal to created_at since logs are immutable.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit log entry was soft deleted. Always null in practice, since compliance requires retention for 90 days and deletion is forbidden.

models.name: todo_app_auth_logs_of_users
models.description: Subtype entity for authentication logs from users. This table maintains the specific user identity and session information for authentication attempts initiated by regular users. It enforces referential integrity by requiring a non-null user_id and provides a clean separation between user and admin authentication events. Each record is accessible through the main todo_app_auth_logs table via 1:1 relationship.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_auth_log_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the main authentication log entry. This creates a 1:1 relationship with the parent table. {@link todo_app_auth_logs.id}

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who attempted authentication. This is non-nullable and uniquely links to a specific user account. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: user_session_id
plainFields.description: User session identifier for this authentication attempt, used for tracking web sessions. @link todo_app_user_sessions.id

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user's authentication attempt occurred, in UTC.

models.name: todo_app_auth_logs_of_admins
models.description: Subtype entity for authentication logs from administrators. This table maintains the specific admin identity and session information for authentication attempts initiated by administrators. It enforces referential integrity by requiring a non-null admin_id and provides a clean separation between admin and user authentication events. Each record is accessible through the main todo_app_auth_logs table via 1:1 relationship.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_auth_log_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the main authentication log entry. This creates a 1:1 relationship with the parent table. {@link todo_app_auth_logs.id}

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin who attempted authentication. This is non-nullable and uniquely links to a specific admin account. {@link todo_app_admins.id}

plainFields.name: admin_session_id
plainFields.description: Admin session identifier for this authentication attempt, used for tracking administrative sessions. @link todo_app_admin_sessions.id

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin's authentication attempt occurred, in UTC.

models.name: todo_app_backups
models.description: System-generated daily encrypted backup records for user data. This table tracks backup operations for compliance and recovery purposes. Each record represents one backup process initiated for a user's todo data. Refers to underlying todo_app_users to identify the scope of the backup. This is a subsidiary system audit table, not directly interacted with by end users.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user whose data was backed up. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: backup_started_at
plainFields.description: Exact timestamp when the backup process began in UTC. Required to calculate backup duration.

plainFields.name: backup_completed_at
plainFields.description: Exact timestamp when the backup process completed in UTC. Must be after backup_started_at. Used to calculate duration and ensure backup succeeded.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: State of the backup operation. Accepts 'pending', 'success', or 'failed'. Required for compliance reporting.

plainFields.name: size_bytes
plainFields.description: Total size of the encrypted backup file in bytes. Used for storage monitoring and cost estimation.

plainFields.name: encryption_algorithm
plainFields.description: Algorithm used to encrypt the backup data. Must be 'AES-256' as per security requirements.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this backup record was created in the database, not when the backup was performed. Used for audit trail of when the record was logged.
